description: This source file implements DNS record data parsing and comparison functions for various DNS record types such as SRV, A, AAAA, CNAME, PTR, TXT, NSEC, etc., within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: RecordRdata
classes.description: Base class for DNS record data types with validation and comparison functions.

classes.name: SrvRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS SRV record data, including priority, weight, port, and target.

classes.name: ARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents IPv4 DNS A record data.

classes.name: AAAARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents IPv6 DNS AAAA record data.

classes.name: TxtRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS TXT record data, containing multiple text strings.

classes.name: NsecRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS NSEC record data, including bitmap and next domain.

methods.name: HasValidSize
methods.description: Checks if the data size is valid for the given DNS record type.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create DNS record data objects from raw data.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the DNS record type identifier.

methods.name: IsEqual
methods.description: Compares two DNS record data objects for equality.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Retrieves a specific bit from the NSEC bitmap.
